title: Lemongrass Chicken Fajitas
description: Savory lemongrass chicken fajitas with a hint of Mexican spice, served with warm flour tortillas. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the chopped lemongrass, moroccan spice blend, and cumin to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by slicing the cooked chicken and serving it with the vegetables, tortillas, and your favorite toppings.
